content: xterm.js addons under @xterm/* scope: addon-fit (resize), addon-webgl (fastest, GPU-bound, browsers strictly limit concurrent WebGL contexts ~8-16 so only use on the focused terminal), addon-canvas (2D canvas fallback), addon-search (find in scrollback), addon-serialize (snapshot buffer to string/HTML for session restore or to freeze background terminals). Old unscoped xterm-addon-* packages are deprecated.
